name: mcx-core
description: Motorcortex platform context and live parameter access — terminology, how a Motorcortex system is put together, and skills to explore and write the parameter tree of a connected controller through a bundled MCP server.

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Motorcortex Core: the 'uv' command is not installed, so the mcx-core MCP server cannot start. Install it (macOS/Linux: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh  |  Windows: winget install astral-sh.uv) and restart Claude Code."
